ability.text: You have no maximum hand size.

abilities.text: Whenever ~ deals combat damage to a player, roll a d20. Draw cards equal to the result. You have no maximum hand size for the rest of the game.

issues: You have no maximum hand size for the rest of the game. — expected A rest-of-the-game continuous effect on the CONTROLLER (CR 611.2 — duration is stated in the effect and is independent of the source; the dragon dying, being exiled, or changing controller must not end it). — scripted { op: 'gain-ability', ability: { kind: 'static', effect: { kind: 'no-max-hand-size' } } } with no duration. src/engine/game.ts:1327 pushes the granted ability onto the SOURCE permanent's grantedAbilities and only if src.zone === 'battlefield'; src/engine/game.ts:471 then reads no-max-hand-size by scanning p.battlefield. So the effect silently ends the moment the Dragon leaves the battlefield (or its controller changes), and the trigger no-ops entirely if the Dragon is already gone when the trigger resolves. Renders as "it gains ...", i.e. the Dragon, not you. No emblem/player-static op exists in the 10.1 vocabulary, so the clause is approximated rather than expressed. — CR 611.2, 611.2b
